title: Meerkerk Gardens

services.name: Become a Docent
services.desc: Join the Meerkerk Gardens' Grateful Deadheaders. We meet in the Volunteer area in Meerkerk house each Thursday morning; reservations are not needed. Coffee and tea are available throughout the day and we provide lunch so everyone can enjoy some social time after the work is done. Bring your favorite pruners and gloves and join the fun in the Gardens. We deadhead the rhododendrons, weed beds, clear trails, and beautify the world. Meerkerk Gardens is seeking to grow its docent program. If you love gardens, people, and being outdoors, this might be the perfect volunteer opportunity for you. blurb: Engaging with nature, in our gardens or along our woodland trails, nurtures well-being, a sense of calm, and connection. Time outdoors encourages mindfulness, creativity, and a sense of wonder. Come for a walk and find tranquility. Immerse yourself.
